def: to alter; by implication, to barter, to dispose of

words.word: and if he shall at all
against me therefore will i change

occurrences.text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
words: and if he shall at all

occurrences.text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the Lord.
As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
words: against me therefore will I change

occurrences.text: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
